answer: Make every identity pay a burn: to register, an agent must send a non-trivial base-layer fee to an unspendable burn address. Basalt is cheap in bulk, but a forge that must melt opal-priced fuel for each brick prices out mass production — likewise, a sybil farmer pays the burn per fake identity, with cost scaling linearly and provably on-chain, no trust required. A yarrow stalk is trivial to fake, yet a forest of them is not: cheap to grow one, ruinous to grow ten thousand. Limit: it prices out honest but broke newcomers, and a deep-pocketed attacker can still afford the fire.
